biocatalyst: Whole cells of E. coli BL21 expressing HheG (Halohydrin dehalogenase from Ilumatobacter coccineus), used as harvested (wet cell) or as cell lysate (after lysozyme treatment).
concentration_determination_method: Wet cell weight was used for concentration (g/L). Enzyme activity was evaluated by monitoring product formation via gas chromatography (GC).
purification_method: Cells were harvested by centrifugation (6000 rpm) and stored at -20°C. For lysate, cells were pre-treated with lysozyme (1 g/L, 37°C, 1 hr) to obtain soluble enzyme-containing supernatant.
